title: Electrically Tunable Valley-Based Qubits in Moiré Quantum Dots
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures; includes 4-page Supplemental Material with 1 figure
summary: The search for scalable, electrically controlled qubits remains a central challenge in quantum technology. We introduce gate-defined moiré quantum dots as a promising platform for valley-based qubits. Moiré engineering resolves the central conflict of valley physics: momentum-space separation protects the states, while the enlarged moiré length scale allows smooth gates to mix them controllably. Dot geometry and confinement strength program valley hybridization, while a displacement field controls detuning, providing two noncommuting electrostatic axes for qubit control.

title: Topological Charge-Transfer Excitons
summary: Excitons possess internal structure absent from single-particle Bloch particles, allowing their band topology to emerge from the bound-state structure rather than being inherited from their constituents. This raises the question of how the internal structure of a bound state can provide a microscopic origin of exciton topology. Here we show that the real-space embedding of charge-transfer excitons can generate an intrinsic manifold of symmetry-related off-site composite orbitals whose coupling supports topological exciton bands. Lateral electron-hole separation embeds the localized exciton on the bond connecting its constituent sites rather than on either site. We demonstrate this mechanism in a honeycomb lattice, where three bond-centered charge-transfer exciton orbitals form a Kagome lattice. By solving the Bethe-Salpeter equation, we show that this emergent multi-orbital manifold supports a topological exciton flat band upon time-reversal symmetry breaking, even when the electron and hole bands are topologically trivial. The resulting band exhibits nearly uniformly distributed quantum geometry, favorable for interaction-driven bosonic states. Our results establish a general route toward topological bands of localized composite bound states and unconventional strongly correlated bosonic phases.

title: Impact of spin-orbit coupling on electron correlation corrections to the density of states in anisotropic conductors
summary: We study Altshuler-Aronov-type interaction corrections to the single-particle density of states (DOS) in a strongly anisotropic 2D conductor with an open Fermi surface (FS) and weak disorder, in the presence of coexisting Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit couplings (SOCs) constrained to the longitudinal direction. The low-energy band consists of two warped sheets weakly tunnel-coupled transversely; SOC splits the sheets into helicity branches with a fixed spin axis. Working in a Matsubara space, we compute the exchange contribution in the diffusion channel with dynamically screened Coulomb interaction and an impurity ladder. The resulting DOS anomaly exhibits a dimensional crossover governed by the transverse coupling scale $\varepsilon_c$. Close to the Fermi level ($|\varepsilon-\varepsilon_F|<\varepsilon_c$), the system behaves two-dimensionally, featuring a logarithmic DOS dip whose magnitude is enhanced by intrinsic SOCs. Further from the Fermi level ($|\varepsilon-\varepsilon_F|\!>\!\varepsilon_c$), the system behaves quasi-one-dimensionally, featuring a sharper square-root singularity whose amplitude is remarkably enhanced by the SOCs. Notably, we identify a critical SOC strength at which these spin-orbit effects exactly cancel the electron-correlation correction, perfectly restoring the unperturbed density of states. Furthermore, increasing the SOC beyond this critical point inverts the sign of the anomaly entirely, yielding a positive DOS correction. This sign reversal fundamentally alters the energy dependence, such that at energies beyond $\varepsilon_F + \varepsilon_c$, the positive correction decays to smaller values as energy increases, opposite to the standard negative correction. This contrasting trend provides a distinct spectroscopic signature of SOC-modulated correlation effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有开费米面的强各向异性二维导体中，由自旋轨道耦合（Rashba和Dresselhaus）调制的Altshuler-Aronov型相互作用对态密度（DOS）的修正。研究发现态密度异常呈现由横向耦合尺度ε_c控制的维度交叉，并识别出临界自旋轨道耦合强度，在该强度下自旋轨道效应可完全抵消电子关联修正，甚至反转异常符号。
AI.motivation: 理解自旋轨道耦合如何影响弱无序导体中的电子-电子相互作用修正（Altshuler-Aronov效应），特别是在具有开费米面的强各向异性系统中，探索SOC对态密度异常的调控作用及其潜在的光谱学签名。
AI.method: 在Matsubara空间中，考虑纵向约束的Rashba和Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合，采用动态屏蔽库仑相互作用和杂质阶梯近似，计算扩散通道中的交换贡献，分析能带结构（两个弯曲片层弱隧穿耦合，SOC将其分裂为固定自旋轴的螺旋度分支）对DOS修正的影响。
AI.result: 发现在费米能级附近（|ε-ε_F|ε_c）呈现更尖锐的平方根奇异，幅度被SOC显著增强。关键在于识别出临界SOC强度：低于该值时SOC增强负修正，等于该值时完全恢复未扰动DOS，超过该值时异常符号反转产生正DOS修正，且在ε_F+ε_c之外正修正随能量增加而衰减（与标准负修正趋势相反）。
AI.conclusion: 自旋轨道耦合可作为一种强效调控手段，不仅能增强或抵消Altshuler-Aronov型DOS修正，甚至能完全反转其符号和能量依赖趋势，提供了SOC-关联效应耦合的独特光谱学特征。

title: One-dimensional Dirac modes in the core of a pentagonal topological crystalline insulator nanowire
summary: We investigate the electronic band topology of recently fabricated pentagonal IV-VI semiconductor nanowires, which contain five radial $\{111\}$ twin planes meeting at the nanowire axis. Tight-binding calculations show that, when the bulk band structure is inverted and the twin planes in the nanowire are cationic, the spectrum contains two spatially separated helical Dirac crossings near $\overlineΓ$: one localized at the core and the other at the outer surface. When the twin planes are anionic, the corresponding spectra remain gapped. The crossings originate from the hybridization of five helical channels associated with the twin-plane edges, whose odd number leaves one Kramers pair near the nanowire axis and the other at the outer boundary. Realistic multiorbital calculations for $\mathrm{Pb}_{0.4}\mathrm{Sn}_{0.6}\mathrm{Te}$ predict well-developed core and surface modes at nanowire thicknesses of approximately 50~nm and above. These results establish pentagonal SnTe-class nanowires as an experimentally accessible realization of spatially separated helical channels bound to the axial defect and the outer boundary.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了最近制备的五边形IV-VI族半导体纳米线的电子带拓扑性质。紧束缚计算表明，当体态能带反转且纳米线中孪晶面为阳离子时，光谱在Γ点附近包含两个空间分离的螺旋Dirac交叉点：一个位于核心，一个位于外表面。当孪晶面为阴离子时，光谱保持有隙。这些交叉源于五个孪晶面边缘螺旋通道的杂化，奇数个通道导致一个Kramers对靠近纳米线轴心，另一个位于外边界。对Pb0.4Sn0.6Te的多轨道计算预测在约50nm以上厚度时存在良好发展的核心和表面模式。
AI.motivation: 利用五边形SnTe类纳米线中径向孪晶面结构，探索实现空间分离螺旋通道的可行途径，为拓扑量子器件提供新的实验可行平台。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚计算和现实多轨道计算（针对Pb0.4Sn0.6Te），分析五边形IV-VI半导体纳米线中孪晶面（阳离子/阴离子）对电子带拓扑和螺旋态的影响。
AI.result: 阳离子孪晶面条件下，光谱中出现两个空间分离的螺旋Dirac交叉点（核心和外表面）；阴离子孪晶面则保持有隙。五条边缘螺旋通道的奇偶数杂化决定了Kramers对的空间分布。多轨道计算表明约50nm及以上厚度的纳米线中能形成良好的核心和表面模式。
AI.conclusion: 五边形SnTe类纳米线可作为实验上可实现的空间分离螺旋通道平台，分别束缚于轴向缺陷和外边界，为拓扑电子学研究提供了新的候选材料体系。

title: Cooperative adsorption and diffusion trapping induced by AlF3 intercalation in graphite
summary: Graphite's structural and electronic response to molecular intercalation is central to its performance as a carbon-based electrode material, yet the microscopic coupling between subsurface intercalation and surface adsorption remains poorly understood. We present a first-principles investigation of AlF3 adsorption and intercalation in graphite to explain the microscopic origin of a recently observed two-step self-limiting sorption mechanism. Using density functional theory (DFT-D3), we show that a single intercalated AlF3 molecule locally transforms the structure, electronic properties, and diffusion behavior of graphite through a blister-like surface deformation. Comparing pristine graphite with a graphite surface containing a subsurface intercalated molecule, coverage-dependent adsorption energetics reveal a crossover from repulsive lateral interactions to cooperative binding above the blister, driven by local curvature and intercalation-induced charge redistribution. Diffusion-barrier calculations show that the blister simultaneously acts as a kinetic trap, raising diffusion barriers and transitioning surface mobility from a quasi-barrierless to a thermally activated regime. Charge-density difference and Mulliken population analyses identify the intercalant as a stable electronic reservoir that deepens the surface potential landscape, kinetically immobilizing adsorbed species. Together, these results establish a structure-property relationship for intercalation-induced deformation in graphite, offering a quantitative framework for controlling intercalation efficiency in carbon-based energy storage and conversion systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理DFT-D3计算，研究了AlF3分子在石墨中的嵌入与表面吸附之间的微观耦合机制，揭示了一种由嵌入分子引起的泡状表面变形如何改变石墨的结构、电子性质和扩散行为，从而解释了两步自限性吸附现象的微观起源。
AI.motivation: 石墨作为碳基电极材料，其分子嵌入的结构和电子响应对其性能至关重要，但亚表面嵌入与表面吸附之间的微观耦合机制仍不清楚。理解这一机制对于控制碳基储能系统的嵌入效率具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT-D3）进行第一性原理计算，对比纯净石墨与含有亚表面嵌入分子的石墨表面，分析覆盖度依赖的吸附能、扩散势垒、电荷密度差和Mulliken布居分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：单个嵌入的AlF3分子通过泡状表面变形局部改变石墨结构和电子性质；吸附能从排斥性横向相互作用转变为泡上方的协同结合，由局部曲率和嵌入诱导的电荷重分布驱动；泡同时作为动力学陷阱，提高扩散势垒并将表面迁移从准无障碍转变为热激活模式。
AI.conclusion: 建立了嵌入诱导变形的结构-性能关系，为碳基储能和转换系统中控制嵌入效率提供了定量框架，揭示了嵌入分子作为稳定电子储库加深表面势景观并动力学固定吸附物种的机制。

title: Kinetic Lifshitz invariants and dynamics of nonreciprocal fluctuations in superconductors
summary: We derive the generalized time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory of a disordered noncentrosymmetric superconductor from the Keldysh nonlinear sigma model, using a two-dimensional electron gas with Rashba spin-orbit coupling and an in-plane Zeeman field as a minimal model. On the thermodynamic side we construct the Lifshitz invariants of the free energy, the linear and cubic gradient terms and the momentum-odd part of the quartic vertex, and trace their dependence on disorder. These couplings are governed by a single closed-form kernel controlled by the ratio of the Dyakonov-Perel spin-relaxation rate to temperature, interpolating between the weak-relaxation regime, where the invariants are suppressed, and the relaxation-dominated regime, where the helical modulation of the order parameter saturates at a universal, disorder-independent value. This crossover reconciles conflicting results for the magnetoelectric couplings of dirty Rashba superconductors. Because the theory is formulated on the Keldysh contour, it also determines the dissipative dynamics: the relaxation rate of a fluctuation with pair momentum $\mathbf{q}$, and hence, by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, the Langevin noise power, acquires a term odd in $\mathbf{q}$ and odd in the magnetic field. The structure of this kinetic Lifshitz invariant is dictated by Onsager reciprocity: friction and noise renormalize in lockstep, so equal-time fluctuations remain Gibbsian while the dynamics are nonreciprocal. As applications we compute the superconducting diode efficiency near $T_c$, where the cubic invariant competes with the quartic vertex and with even higher-gradient terms rendered odd by the helical shift, reversing the sign of the diode coefficient, and the fluctuation-induced magnetochiral anisotropy above $T_c$, where the current-resolved nonreciprocal resistance forms a plateau across the Gaussian regime.

AI.tldr: 本文从Keldysh非线性sigma模型出发，推导了无序非中心对称超导体的广义含时Ginzburg-Landau理论。以具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合和面内Zeeman场的二维电子气为最小模型，构造了自由能的Lifshitz不变量、线性和三次梯度项以及四次顶点的动量奇部分，并追踪其与无序的依赖关系。这些耦合由单个闭式核函数控制，该核函数由Dyakonov-Perel自旋弛豫率与温度之比决定，在弱弛豫区间（不变量被抑制）和弛豫主导区间（螺旋调制达到无序无关的普适值）之间插值。这一交叉调和了脏Rashba超导体磁电耦合的相互矛盾的结果。由于理论在Keldysh轮廓上构建，它也决定了耗散动力学：具有对动量q的涨落的弛豫率，进而通过涨落-耗散定理得到Langevin噪声功率，获得q奇且磁场奇的一项。该动力学Lifshitz不变量的结构由Onsager互易性决定：摩擦和噪声以锁步方式重整化，因此等时涨落保持Gibbs形式而动力学是非互易的。作为应用，文章计算了T_c附近的超导二极管效率（三次不变量与四次顶点及螺旋移动引起的更高梯度项竞争，使二极管系数变号），以及T_c以上的涨落诱导磁手征各向异性（电流分辨的非互易电阻在Gauss区域形成平台）。

AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个统一的理论框架，从微观层面统一描述了无序非中心对称超导体的热力学与动力学性质，揭示了磁电耦合从无序敏感到普适饱和的交叉机制，澄清了此前的理论争议。该框架不仅适用于静态磁电效应，还扩展到了非互易动力学和涨落效应，为理解超导二极管效应、磁手征各向异性等非中心对称超导体的核心现象提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Physics-Based Molecular Fingerprints from Spectral Graph Theory Provide Efficient Geometry-Aware Measures of Chemical Similarity
summary: Molecular representations are essential for the evaluation of molecular similarity and the development of structure-property relationships. Despite the known importance of 3D structure to determine chemical and physical properties, the most widely used molecular fingerprints encode only two-dimensional connectivity. Such representations fail to distinguish similar but distinct stereoisomers and conformers. Alternative 3D methods are typically defined pairwise, making their application to large chemical spaces prohibitive, while deep learning embeddings are expressive but uninterpretable and limited by their training data diversity. Here, we introduce novel physics-inspired molecular fingerprints based on principles from spectral graph theory. We represent molecules as a complete graph in 3D space, with edge weights encoding heuristic physical interactions. Eigenvalue decomposition of the resulting graph Laplacian matrix results in a computationally efficient fixed-length chemical fingerprint that encodes 3D structure while obeying necessary physical symmetries of permutation and E(3) invariance. Spectral fingerprints differentiate between unique molecular structures with identical 2D connectivity, overcoming a limitation of 2D descriptors, while maintaining the low computational cost needed for efficient screening of vast chemical spaces. We evaluate our fingerprints with community detection algorithms and observe strong performance against representative baselines across datasets from organic, inorganic, biological, reticular, and reaction chemistry. Nearest-neighbor property estimation and applicability domain analyses reveal the utility of our molecular representation in machine learning and cheminformatics. We anticipate that spectral fingerprints will serve as generalizable, interpretable, and efficient measures of chemical similarity that incorporate 3D information at minimal cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于谱图理论的物理学启发式分子指纹（spectral fingerprints），通过将分子表示为3D空间中的完全图，利用图拉普拉斯矩阵的特征值分解生成固定长度的化学指纹，能够编码3D结构信息的同时满足置换不变性和E(3)不变性，解决了传统2D指纹无法区分立体异构体的问题，并保持了高通量筛选所需的计算效率。

title: Multiphysics tritium transport modelling of the ARC breeding blanket with FESTIM
summary: Accurate prediction of tritium behaviour in molten salt breeding blankets is essential for the design and safe operation of ARC-class fusion reactors. This work presents a fully open-source, component-scale multiphysics framework for modelling tritium transport in an ARC liquid immersion blanket. Neutron transport, thermal hydraulics, and hydrogen isotope transport are coupled using OpenMC, OpenFOAM, and FESTIM, leveraging dedicated tools enabling direct transfer of spatially resolved fields between solvers. Assuming a zero inlet concentration, steady-state simulations predict a total tritium inventory of approximately 243 mg, with the blanket reaching steady-state tritium throughput within approximately 30 min, which is of a similar order to previous system-level estimates. The results show that tritium transport is dominated by turbulence-enhanced diffusion, with strong localisation in flow stagnation regions and reduced accumulation in highly turbulent zones. Sensitivity analyses indicate that predicted inventories are governed primarily by the numerical stabilisation scheme, with only a modest dependence on the turbulent Schmidt number. The proposed workflow provides a transparent and extensible basis for high-fidelity analysis of tritium transport in ARC-class breeding blankets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个完全开源的组件尺度多物理场框架，用于模拟ARC类聚变反应堆液态沉浸包层中的氚输运行为。通过耦合OpenMC、OpenFOAM和FESTIM三个求解器，实现了中子输运、热工水力和氢同位素输运的联合模拟。稳态模拟预测总氚库存约243 mg，包层约30分钟内达到稳态氚通量，与先前系统级估计相当。结果显示氚输运由湍流增强扩散主导，流动滞留区存在强局部化，高湍流区累积减少。

AI.method: 采用完全开源的多物理场耦合框架，将OpenMC（中子输运）、OpenFOAM（热工水力）和FESTIM（氢同位素输运）三个求解器耦合，利用专用工具实现求解器间空间分辨场的直接传递，对ARC液态沉浸包层进行稳态氚输运模拟，并开展敏感性分析。
AI.result: 预测总氚库存约243 mg，包层约30分钟内达到稳态氚通量；氚输运由湍流增强扩散主导，在流动滞留区呈现强局部化，高湍流区累积减少；敏感性分析表明预测库存主要受数值稳定化方案控制，对湍流Schmidt数依赖较小。

title: Nucleation beyond Equilibrium: Fronts Control Invasion in Bistable Ecosystems
summary: Bistability, the existence of two alternative stable states with distinct basins of attraction, is common across ecology and many other biological, chemical, and physical systems. In spatially extended systems, the invasion of one state by the other proceeds through nucleation, the fluctuation-driven growth of a droplet beyond a critical size. Classical Nucleation Theory (CNT) quantifies this process using the energy landscape, but this description relies on detailed balance, the condition of microscopic reversibility that holds at equilibrium. Ecological dynamics generally violate detailed balance and are described not by a single scalar field but by several coupled, non-conserved abundances--a vector order parameter--for which no general nucleation theory exists. Here we derive such a theory for reaction-diffusion systems with a non-conserved vector order parameter, valid both close to the binodal, where invasion proceeds through propagating fronts, and close to the spinodal, where the metastable state loses stability. Extensive numerical computations of the quasipotential confirm the theory in both regimes. We show that the mathematical structure of CNT survives out of equilibrium, once energetic quantities are replaced by dynamical properties of fronts: the front speed plays the role of the bulk free-energy difference between phases, and the diffusivity that of the surface tension. Applied to the two-species Lotka-Volterra model, an archetypal system of bistable ecological antagonism, our theory shows that strong interspecific competition generates a pronounced depletion region within fronts, where the total abundance falls well below carrying capacity. This vectorial structure, invisible to a scalar description based on species frequency alone, makes invasion exponentially harder as competition strengthens at fixed competitive advantage--a prediction testable in microbial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了非守恒矢量序参量反应-扩散系统中双稳态相互入侵的成核理论，将经典成核理论推广到远离平衡态（不满足细致平衡）的生态系统中。该理论在双稳态边界附近和旋节线附近均有效，并通过拟势的大量数值计算验证。应用于两物种Lotka-Volterra模型时，理论揭示了强种间竞争会导致前锋内出现显著的物种耗竭区域，使得入侵难度随竞争强度指数级增加。
AI.motivation: 经典成核理论(CNT)依赖于详细平衡（微观可逆性）这一平衡条件，但生态动力学通常不满足详细的平衡条件，并且由多个耦合、非守恒的丰度场（矢量序参量）描述，而目前缺乏针对这类系统的通用成核理论。
AI.method: 为非守恒矢量序参量的反应-扩散系统推导成核理论，该理论在双稳态边界附近（通过传播前锋入侵）和旋节线附近（亚稳态失去稳定性）均有效。用拟势的大量数值计算在两个区域验证理论，并通过两物种Lotka-Volterra模型进行应用和检验。

AI.conclusion: 该理论为远离平衡态的多物种生态系统的成核与入侵提供了统一框架，揭示了仅基于物种频率的标量描述无法看到的矢量结构效应，并给出了可在微生物系统中检验的定量预测。

title: Superconducting and charge-ordered phases from Dirac quantum spin liquids on the triangular lattice
summary:
Triangular-lattice quantum spin-liquid insulators are observed to undergo transitions to superconductivity under pressure or doping, and exhibit enhanced terahertz conductivity when driven by mid-infrared light. We present a general theoretical framework for the emergence of superconducting and charge-ordered phases from a U(1) Dirac spin liquid with fermionic spinons, as well as from its gapped $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and chiral descendants. Numerical studies have provided substantial evidence for these spin-liquid states.
  The spin-liquid phase hosts fractionalized Dirac spinons coupled to an emergent gauge field, whereas the superconducting and charge-ordered phases are conventional, with neither fractionalized excitations nor emergent gauge dynamics. The transition between these phases is driven by the Higgs condensation of spinless charge-$e$ bosonic chargons (``doublons'' and ``holons''). We show that the projective symmetry group of the Dirac spinons uniquely determines the symmetry and dispersion of the chargons, allowing us to construct an effective low-energy theory near the chargon band minima. Gauge-invariant composites of the chargon Higgs fields provide the order parameters characterizing the phases. The resulting phase diagram contains a rich variety of ordered states, including $d+id$ superconductivity, charge-density waves, bond-density waves, and pair-density waves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，用以解释三角格子量子自旋液体绝缘体在压力或掺杂下向超导转变，以及在中红外光驱动下太赫兹电导增强的物理机制。该框架基于U(1)狄拉克自旋液体中费米子自旋子与涌现规范场的耦合，通过无自旋带电玻色子（chargon）的希格斯凝聚来描述从自旋液体到常规超导和电荷有序相的转变。
AI.motivation: 实验观察到三角格子量子自旋液体绝缘体在压力或掺杂下会发生超导转变，并在中红外光驱动下表现出增强的太赫兹电导，但缺乏一个统一的微观理论框架来解释这些现象及其相互关联。
AI.method: 作者构建了从U(1)狄拉克自旋液体（及其gapped的Z2和手征后代态）出发的一般理论框架。关键步骤包括：(1) 利用投影对称群唯一确定chargon的对称性和色散关系；(2) 在chargon能带极小值附近构建有效低能理论；(3) 通过chargon希格斯场的规范不变复合算符构造描述各相的有序参量；(4) 分析希格斯凝聚驱动的量子相变。
AI.result: 得到的相图包含丰富的有序态，包括d+id超导、电荷密度波、键密度波和配对密度波等。该理论成功地将自旋液体的分数量子激发与常规相的涌现联系起来，解释了从自旋液体到超导等常规相的转变机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解三角格子量子自旋液体向超导和电荷有序态的转变提供了统一的理论框架，展示了投影对称群在决定chargon性质中的核心作用，并为实验观测（如压力/掺杂诱导的超导和光驱动太赫兹电导）提供了理论基础。

title: An Effective String Theory Toolbox for Quantum Hall Interfaces I: Worldsheet Kinematics and Constraint Structure
summary: A freely moving quantum Hall interface is fundamentally different from an ordinary edge fixed by an external confining potential. Since a normal displacement changes the areas occupied by the adjacent incompressible phases, the interface geometry and charge dynamics cannot be treated as independent degrees of freedom. We formulate this problem for interfaces between Abelian quantum Hall phases using a spatially reparametrization-invariant worldsheet description, in which tangential motion is a relabeling of the interface while normal motion is physical. Starting from the two-sided Chern--Simons response, we derive the relation between normal charge transport and interface motion. We then introduce a relative-area construction, defined with respect to a material reference curve, that converts this velocity relation into an equal-time constraint linking the charged boundary sector to the interface shape. Combined with the folded $K$-matrix current algebra, this identifies the universal Hall kinematics of the moving interface while leaving its geometric energy and neutral dynamics dependent on microscopic interface physics. The resulting framework provides a systematic basis for effective theories of dynamical quantum Hall interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个描述自由移动量子霍尔界面的理论框架，区别于被外部势能固定的普通边界。通过空间重参数化不变的worldsheet描述，结合两侧Chern-Simons响应和相对面积构造，推导出界面运动与电荷输运之间的联系，并建立了将带电边界扇区与界面形状关联的等时约束。
AI.motivation: 自由移动的量子霍尔界面与普通固定边界有本质区别——界面的法向位移会改变相邻不可压缩相所占的面积，因此界面几何构型与电荷动力学不能作为独立自由度处理。现有理论缺乏对这种耦合的系统性描述。
AI.method: 1) 使用空间重参数化不变的worldsheet描述，其中切向运动仅是界面重标定，法向运动才是物理的。2) 从两侧Chern-Simons响应出发推导法向电荷输运与界面运动的速度关系。3) 引入相对于材料参考曲线的相对面积构造，将该速度关系转化为等时约束。4) 结合折叠K矩阵流代数，识别移动界面的普适Hall运动学。
AI.result: 建立了连接带电边界扇区与界面形状的等时约束，识别出移动界面的普适Hall运动学。界面几何能量和中性动力学依赖于微观界面物理，而运动学部分具有普适性。该框架为动力学量子霍尔界面的有效理论提供了系统基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究自由移动量子霍尔界面的动力学提供了统一的系统框架，明确了普适运动学与依赖微观细节的动力学之间的划分，可指导未来有效理论模型的构建。

title: Nitrogen Vacancy Centers in Hexagonal Diamond Exhibit Long Coherence Times
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, data and codes uploaded on QRESP after final peer review complete
summary: We show that negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in the hexagonal diamond polymorph lonsdaleite offer a route to spin qubits with enhanced coherence relative to their cubic-diamond counterparts. Using first-principles calculations, we examine two distinct defect configurations, AA, with the same symmetry as in cubic diamond and AB, with reduced symmetry. We find that the AB configuration of the NV center exhibits a finite transverse zero-field splitting, giving rise to an approximate fourfold enhancement of the Hahn-echo coherence time $T_2$ at zero magnetic field. The AA configuration, by contrast, closely reproduces the electronic structure and coherence properties of the cubic NV center. We further characterize the many-body electronic structure, vertical excitation energies, and photoluminescence spectra of both configurations, providing spectral fingerprints for their experimental identification. Our results establish symmetry-broken NV centers in lonsdaleite as promising candidates for quantum sensing and information science applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了六方金刚石多晶型（朗斯代尔石）中带负电的氮-空位（NV）中心，发现其AB构型具有有限的横向零场分裂，在零磁场下可将Hahn-echo相干时间T₂提高约4倍，为量子传感和信息科学提供了有前景的自旋量子比特方案。
AI.motivation: 立方金刚石中的NV中心是成熟的量子比特平台，但其相干性受到核自旋环境等因素限制。作者探索具有不同晶格对称性的六方金刚石（朗斯代尔石）中的NV中心，以期通过对称性破缺获得增强的相干特性，为量子信息应用开辟新途径。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算方法，研究了朗斯代尔石中NV中心的两种缺陷构型：AA构型（与立方金刚石NV中心具有相同对称性）和AB构型（对称性降低）。计算了电子结构、多体性质、垂直激发能和光致发光光谱，并评估了零场分裂和Hahn-echo相干时间。

AI.conclusion: 朗斯代尔石中对称性破缺的NV中心（AB构型）通过增强的零场相干性，为量子传感和量子信息科学提供了有前景的候选材料平台，且其独特的光谱指纹有助于实验验证。

title: Annular Majorana mode in a superconducting topological insulator
summary: When the surface states of a topological insulator becomes superconducting, topological superconductivity can be obtained, and each vortex on the surface can host one single Majorana zero-energy mode which is usually a wave packet decaying exponentially off the vortex core. Here, we predict stable Majorana zero-energy mode whose wave function is ring-shape, dubbed as annular Majorana mode, in the superconducting vortex in topological insulators respecting $3$-fold or $6$-fold rotational symmetry. Such topological insulators are featured with a single nonlinear Dirac cone located at $\barΓ$ or three linear Dirac cones at $\bar{\text{M}}$ in the surface Brillouin zone. The annular Majorana mode originates from the effective chiral $f$-wave superconductivity on the nonlinear Dirac cone in the former case and the interference of the effective chiral $p$-wave superconductivity on the three linear Dirac cones in the latter. In both cases, the annular Majorana mode is stabilized by the rotational symmetry and the winding number $3$ carried by the surface states. Candidate materials supporting the annular Majorana mode are predicted. Our work provides new insights into the topological superconductivity in superconducting topological insulators.

AI.tldr: 本文在具有3重或6重旋转对称性的拓扑绝缘体超导涡旋中，预测了一种稳定的环形马约拉纳零能模，其波函数呈环状而非传统的指数衰减波包，源于非线性能带的赝手性f波超导或三个线性狄拉克锥的赝手性p波超导干涉，并由旋转对称性和表面态绕数3所稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统拓扑绝缘体表面超导涡旋中，马约拉纳零能模通常为局域在涡旋核附近的指数衰减波包。作者希望探索在具有特殊旋转对称性的拓扑绝缘体中，是否存在波函数呈环形分布的新型马约纳拉零能模，从而拓展对拓扑超导态的理解。
AI.method: 作者在具有3重或6重旋转对称性的拓扑绝缘体中，研究表面超导涡旋的马约纳拉零能模。这类拓扑绝缘体在表面布里渊区中表现为位于Γ点的单个非线性狄拉克锥，或位于M点的三个线性狄拉克锥。前者产生赝手性f波超导，后者通过三个线性狄拉克锥的赝手性p波超导干涉形成环形马约纳拉模，通过旋转对称性和表面态绕数3来实现稳定性。
AI.result: 预测了稳定的环形马约纳拉零能模，其波函数呈环状分布而非传统的核区局域形态。在非线性狄拉克锥情形下源于赝手性f波超导，在三个线性狄拉克锥情形下源于赝手性p波超导的干涉。环形马约纳拉模由旋转对称性和表面态绕数3共同稳定，并给出了候选材料。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次预测了环形马约纳拉零能模这一新型拓扑量子态，为拓扑绝缘体超导系统中的拓扑超导研究提供了新的见解，并指出了可能实现该现象的具体候选材料。

title: Next Generation of Ultra-Coarse-Graining: Self-Consistent Inference of Critical Internal States
summary: Bottom-up coarse-graining expands the length and time scales accessible to molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, but information loss can hinder accurate representation of multistate phenomena in complex biomolecular dynamics. Ultra-Coarse-Graining (UCG) projects discrete "quantum-like" extended degrees of freedom, or "internal states," onto coarse-grained (CG) molecules, extending CG model expressiveness. The rapid-local-equilibrium (RLE) approximation in UCG depends on user-defined collective variables (CVs, e.g., local density) and neglects correlations between internal states within and between CG molecules. We present Self-Consistent UCG (SC-UCG), which uses the underlying UCG interactions directly to assign internal states without designing CVs in the CG ensemble. During simulation, internal state probabilities are determined self-consistently through graph message passing. We enhance the RLE Hamiltonian with the Bethe approximation and AI-based inference to represent explicit correlations between UCG beads. For force-field training, we develop Multilayer Internal State Consistency (MISC), a machine-learning method derived from relative entropy minimization that avoids iterative sampling of intermediate force fields. We apply SC-UCG to a tetramer exhibiting a second-order symmetry-breaking phase transition from a supercritical racemic fluid to subcritical D-rich and L-rich fluids. SC-UCG captures collective switching of internal states in the subcritical region and recapitulates the phase transition across temperatures, despite being trained on a single-temperature dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自洽超粗粒化（SC-UCG）方法，通过图消息传递实现内部状态概率的自洽确定，并用Bethe近似和AI推理增强RLE哈密顿量以表征UCG珠子间的显式关联。结合多层内部状态一致性（MISC）机器学习训练方法，该方法在单温度数据集训练下成功捕捉了四聚体的二级对称性破缺相变。
AI.motivation: 传统UCG方法依赖用户自定义的集体变量（CVs）且忽略了CG分子内和分子间的内部状态关联，导致无法准确表征复杂生物分子动力学中的多态现象。作者旨在消除RLE近似中对人工CV的依赖，并显式建模内部状态间的相关性。
AI.method: SC-UCG方法包含三个核心创新：(1) 直接利用底层UCG相互作用分配内部状态，无需在CG系综中设计CVs；(2) 在模拟过程中通过图消息传递自洽确定内部状态概率；(3) 用Bethe近似和AI推理增强RLE哈密顿量表征关联。力场训练方面提出MISC方法，基于相对熵最小化推导，避免迭代采样中间力场。
AI.result: 将SC-UCG应用于四聚体体系，成功捕捉了从超临界外消旋流体到次临界D-rich和L-rich流体的二级对称性破缺相变。该方法能捕获次临界区域内部状态的集体切换，并在仅用单温度数据集训练的情况下重现跨温度的相变行为。
AI.conclusion: SC-UCG克服了传统UCG对人工CV的依赖和关联信息丢失的问题，提供了一种更通用、更准确的粗粒化方法，能够表征多态复杂生物分子动力学中的相变和集体行为。

title: Data-driven reconstruction of dynamical systems using Takens' Theorem, manifold learning, and universal function approximators
summary: Embedding theorems can be used to provide theoretical guarantees about the relation between low-dimensional observations of a system and its full-dimensional state and dynamics. Such theorems do not, however, provide guidance on observable choice, embedding construction, or methodologies to learn the mapping between the embedding and full-dimensional state. In this work, we develop an algorithmic framework, TAkens Reconstruction (TAR), to analyze and reconstruct arbitrary dynamical systems from low-dimensional time series using an integration of Takens' Delay Embedding Theorem, manifold learning techniques, and universal function approximators. We validate TAR in applications to a variety of simulated and observed dynamical systems and use it to investigate how delay vector structure impacts reconstruction accuracy. In an ecological system, we show that simple predator-prey dynamics can be reconstructed with observations taken over a wide variety of embedding time scales. In molecular dynamics simulations of the protein Villin, we demonstrate how including multiple time delays of the same observable series can be used to improve reconstruction of systems with multiple characteristic time scales. In the trade record of Vanguard S&P 500, we show how the approach exposes underlying dynamical phenomenologies in the data and accurate return predictions over short time horizons without access to full-dimensional market observations. We develop and release an open-source software package to enable the application of TAR to arbitrary dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TAkens Reconstruction (TAR)的算法框架，将Takens延迟嵌入定理、流形学习技术和通用函数逼近器相结合，用于从低维时间序列数据中分析和重建任意动力学系统。该框架在多个模拟和实际系统中得到验证，包括生态捕食-被捕食系统、蛋白质分子动力学模拟和金融时间序列数据。
AI.motivation: 现有的嵌入定理（如Takens延迟嵌入定理）虽然能为低维观测与全维状态/动力学之间提供理论保证，但并未指导如何选择可观测变量、如何构建嵌入，也不提供学习嵌入与全维状态之间映射的方法论。因此需要一个系统化的算法框架来解决这些实际实施中的关键问题。
AI.method: TAR算法框架通过三个核心组件的集成来实现动力学系统重建：(1) Takens延迟嵌入定理提供理论框架，将低维时间序列重构为高维状态空间；(2) 流形学习技术用于从重构的延迟向量中有效提取底层流形结构；(3) 通用函数逼近器用于学习嵌入空间与全维状态之间的映射关系。算法还系统性地研究了延迟向量结构（如多个时间延迟的组合）对重建精度的影响。
AI.result: 在生态系统中，TAR能够在广泛的嵌入时间尺度下成功重建简单的捕食-被捕食动力学。在Villin蛋白的分子动力学模拟中，通过在同一可观测序列中加入多个时间延迟，改善了具有多特征时间尺度的系统的重建效果。在Vanguard S&P 500交易记录中，该方法能够揭示数据背后的动力学现象学特征，并在无需全维市场观测的情况下实现短期回报的准确预测。
AI.conclusion: TAR提供了一个通用、可操作的算法框架，弥合了嵌入定理理论与实际应用之间的鸿沟，并已作为开源软件包发布，使研究者能够将该方法应用于任意动力学系统。

title: Theory of Measurement-Altered Criticality
summary: Local measurements can alter long-range correlations in gapless quantum matter. We propose a theory of weakly-monitored Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids, a broad class of quantum critical states in one dimension. In order to address the intrinsic randomness of the measurement record, we develop a replica instanton calculation to study Born-averaged observables. We find that when measurements are relevant, average correlators of density and phase fluctuations decay at long distances as universal power laws with logarithmic corrections, a feature we argue is peculiar to measurement-induced randomness. We characterize the full multifractal spectrum of moments of correlations functions, revealing broad, strongly non-gaussian fluctuations across the ensemble of post-measurement states. We support these analytic results with matrix-product-state calculations, and provide a general picture of measurement-altered criticality for ground states described by 1+1d conformal field theories. Our results establish that physical measurements alter critical quantum states in a manner that lies beyond both forced measurements and conventional critical scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了弱监测Tomonaga-Luttinger液体的理论，通过replica瞬子计算方法研究Born平均观测量，发现测量的相关性会导致密度和相位涨落关联函数出现带对数修正的普适幂律衰减，并表征了关联函数矩的多重分形谱，揭示了测量后态系综中广泛存在的强非高斯涨落。
AI.motivation: 局部测量可以改变无间隙量子物质中的长程关联，但如何理解弱监测下的量子临界态，特别是测量记录本身随机性带来的效应，尚未有完整的理论框架。传统方法无法捕捉Born平均观测量中测量诱导随机性的本质特征。
AI.method: 开发了replica瞬子计算方法来研究Born平均观测量，分析密度和相位涨落关联函数的矩，并辅以矩阵乘积态(MPS)数值计算验证解析结果。该方法处理了测量记录内在随机性的挑战。
AI.result: 发现当测量相关时，平均关联函数在长距离上表现为带对数修正的普适幂律衰减，这一特征被论证为测量诱导随机性所特有。完整表征了关联函数矩的多重分形谱，显示出横跨测量后态系综的宽泛、强非高斯涨落，并与MPS数值计算一致。
AI.conclusion: 物理测量以超越强制测量和常规临界标度的方式来改变临界量子态，为1+1维共形场论描述的基态提供了测量改变临界性的普适图像。

title: Self-dual $S_3$ gauge theory in 2+1d: lattice model and topological phase transitions
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 18 pages of supplementary materials
summary: Electric-magnetic self-duality of the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge theory, realized microscopically as a half-lattice-translation exchanging electric charge and magnetic flux, has been an influential example of a duality symmetry with an exact lattice realization. We construct the first non-Abelian generalization of this construction: a lattice model of the $S_3$ quantum double $\mathcal{D}(S_3)$ on a tensor product Hilbert space in which the $\mathbb{Z}^{\mathrm{em}}_2$ anyon-permutation symmetry, exchanging the non-Abelian chargeon $C$ and fluxon $F$, is realized via lattice translation. Consequently we find that the zigzag boundary termination of the model realizes, without fine-tuning, a gapless critical edge state described by the tetracritical Ising CFT. The bulk admits three independent $\mathbb{Z}_2^{\mathrm{em}}$-preserving bosonic perturbations, driving $\mathcal{D}(S_3)$ into distinct gapped phases. We analyze these transitions by three independent methods: category-theoretic anyon condensation, microscopic lattice Hamiltonians, and Chern-Simons-Higgs theory, which all agree, yielding a unified picture. These examples motivate a minimal-condensation principle: proliferating a bosonic anyon generically drives condensation of a minimal condensable algebra containing it, with symmetry-related condensates appearing as degenerate vacua that spontaneously break the anyon-permutation symmetry. Our model construction extends to an infinite family of self-dual dihedral quantum doubles $\mathcal{D}(D_{2n})$. Notably, each model is sign-problem-free, opening the door to large-scale numerical exploration of the phases of non-Abelian Chern-Simons-Higgs theories.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了第一个非阿贝尔自偶对偶的格点模型：在$S_3$量子双$\mathcal{D}(S_3)$的张量积希尔伯特空间上，通过格点平移实现交换非阿贝尔电荷子$C$和磁通子$F$的$\mathbb{Z}^{\mathrm{em}}_2$任意子置换对称性。该模型在之字形边界上无需微调即可实现由四临界Ising CFT描述的无质量临界边缘态。作者通过三种独立方法（范畴论任意子凝聚、微观格点哈密顿量、Chern-Simons-Higgs理论）分析了体态中三个独立的$\mathbb{Z}^{\mathrm{em}}_2$保持玻色子微扰驱动的相变，三者一致得出统一图景，并提出"最小凝聚原理"。该构造可推广到无限族自偶二面体量子双$\mathcal{D}(D_{2n})$，且模型无符号问题，为大规模数值研究非阿贝尔Chern-Simons-Higgs理论相图开辟了新道路。
AI.motivation: $\mathbb{Z}_2$规范理论的电磁自偶性（通过半格点平移实现）是精确格点实现的对偶对称性的经典范例，但此前的构造局限于阿贝尔情形。作者希望将这种"通过平移实现电磁对偶"的构造推广到非阿贝尔情况，以探索更丰富的对偶对称性及其伴随的相变行为。
AI.method: 作者在$\mathcal{D}(S_3)$量子双上构造了第一类非阿贝尔格点模型，通过格点平移实现$\mathbb{Z}^{\mathrm{em}}_2$任意子置换对称性。分析手段包括：(1) 范畴论的任意子凝聚方法；(2) 微观格点哈密顿量分析；(3) Chern-Simons-Higgs场论方法。三种方法交叉验证，并提出"最小凝聚原理"概括相变规律。模型推广到$\mathcal{D}(D_{2n})$族。
AI.result: 构造了$S_3$量子双的非阿贝尔自偶格点模型，其之字形边界自然实现四临界Ising CFT描述的无质量临界边缘态。体态中三个独立的$\mathbb{Z}^{\mathrm{em}}_2$保持玻色子扰动驱动$\mathcal{D}(S_3)$进入不同的有能隙相，三种独立方法分析结果完全一致，支持"最小凝聚原理"：增殖玻色子任意子通常促使包含它的最小可凝聚代数凝聚，对称性相关的凝聚体作为自发破缺任意子置换对称性的简并真空出现。构造推广到无限族自偶二面体量子双$\mathcal{D}(D_{2n})$，且所有模型无符号问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次建立了非阿贝尔版本的电磁自偶对偶格点实现，为研究非阿贝尔对偶对称性、任意子凝聚和相变提供了统一框架。无符号问题的特性使大规模数值模拟成为可能，为探索非阿贝尔Chern-Simons-Higgs理论相图铺平了道路。提出的"最小凝聚原理"为理解任意子凝聚驱动的相变提供了普遍性指导原则。

title: An Effective String Theory Toolbox for Quantum Hall Interfaces II: Majorana Fermions on Fluctuating Moore-Read Worldsheets
summary: A Moore--Read interface carries a chiral Majorana mode on a boundary whose geometry may itself fluctuate. Fixed-edge theory does not determine how this neutral mode should be transported when the interface bends and moves, or how its dynamics couples to the fluctuating shape. Here we construct a spatially reparametrization-invariant Majorana theory on the nonrelativistic worldsheet of a freely moving interface. The changing line element fixes a universal half-density transport law, while additional curvature- and velocity-dependent couplings remain controlled by microscopic interface physics. The resulting framework identifies the Majorana stress tensor as the mediator between neutral and geometric dynamics and provides the neutral sector needed for effective theories of dynamical non-Abelian quantum Hall interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个空间重参数化不变的Majorana理论，用于描述Moore-Read界面上的手性Majorana模在动态弯曲界面上的输运行为，将Majorana应力张量识别为中性模与几何动力学之间的媒介。
AI.motivation: Moore-Read界面上携带手性Majorana模，但固定边界理论无法解释当界面弯曲移动时中性模如何输运，以及其动力学如何与界面形状涨落耦合，需要建立更完整的理论框架。
AI.method: 在自由移动界面的非相对论世界膜上构建空间重参数化不变的Majorana理论，利用变化的线元确定普适的半密度输运定律，并用额外曲率和速度依赖的耦合控制微观界面物理。
AI.result: 识别出Majorana应力张量作为中性动力学与几何动力学之间的媒介，为动态非阿贝尔量子霍尔界面的有效理论提供了所需的中性扇区。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为描述动态非阿贝尔量子霍尔界面的中性模输运与几何耦合提供了统一的理论基础。

title: Fine-Tuning Small Language Models for Reliable VASP INCAR Generation
summary: Language models can prepare VASP INCAR files from natural-language requests, but so far only large proprietary cloud models come close to handling the tightly coupled, physics-sensitive settings reliably, a dependence that fits poorly with local, high-throughput materials workflows where privacy, cost, and offline deployment matter. We show that a small language model (SLM) can close this gap. The SLM is fine-tuned on reference VASP calculations and paired with VASPGuard, a deterministic post-processor that checks syntax, workflow, and material-dependent constraints; we call the combined model INCAR-SLM. On INCARBench, a benchmark for VASP INCAR generation, INCAR-SLM built on Qwen3-4B outperforms every general-purpose LLM evaluated, exceeding GPT-5.4 by 15.55 points on the 100-point INCAR Score. Most of this gain comes from fine-tuning, with VASPGuard correcting the errors that remain. We further find that model size matters less than expected: once fine-tuning and post-processing are applied, performance saturates at a few billion parameters, and Qwen3-4B outperforms larger models in the same family.

AI.tldr: 本文提出INCAR-SLM，一个将小语言模型（基于Qwen3-4B微调）与确定性后处理器VASPGuard相结合的方案，用于从自然语言生成VASP INCAR文件。在INCARBench基准上，INCAR-SLM以100分制超过所有通用大模型，比GPT-5.4高出15.55分，且性能在数十亿参数规模即饱和。
AI.motivation: 现有生成VASP INCAR文件的能力主要依赖大型专有云模型，这与本地化、高通量材料工作流中隐私、成本和离线部署的需求不符。作者希望用小型语言模型（SLM）弥合这一差距，实现可靠且可本地部署的INCAR生成。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：1）在参考VASP计算数据上微调Qwen3-4B小语言模型；2）引入VASPGuard确定性后处理器，用于检查语法、工作流和材料依赖约束。两者组合构成INCAR-SLM系统。
AI.result: 在INCARBench基准上，INCAR-SLM的100分制INCAR Score超过所有已评估的通用LLM，比GPT-5.4高出15.55分。性能增益主要来自微调，VASPGuard用于修正剩余错误。此外发现性能在几十亿参数规模即饱和，Qwen3-4B优于同系列更大模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明通过微调加确定性后处理，小语言模型可以达到甚至超越大型专有模型在VASP INCAR生成上的表现，且模型规模对性能的影响比预期更小，这为本地化、隐私敏感的高通量材料计算工作流提供了可行方案。

title: X-ray Driven Trihydrogen Formation on Silica Nanosurfaces
summary: The trihydrogen cation ($\mathrm{H_3^+}$) initiates the ion-molecule reactions that build molecular complexity in interstellar space. Whether its canonical formation reaction, $\mathrm{H_2^+ + H_2 \rightarrow H_3^+ + H}$, proceeds on inorganic surfaces under radiation-driven ionization has remained untested. Here we drive $\mathrm{H_3^+}$ formation on hydrated silica nanoparticles using intense 1.88 keV X-ray pulses, combining ion velocity map imaging, electron time-of-flight spectroscopy, and single-particle coherent diffractive imaging to resolve this chemistry on individual particles. The self-induced surface electric field on the V/nm scale drives interfacial charge transfer and water fragmentation. This field is the dominant parameter governing the relative yields of $\mathrm{H^+}$, $\mathrm{H_2^+}$, and $\mathrm{H_3^+}$ across particle size, composition, and aggregation. Density functional theory and nonadiabatic quantum molecular dynamics simulations trace this field-driven charge transfer, directly analogous to band bending at semiconductor photoelectrodes. These results establish surface-field-driven charge transfer as a unifying mechanism between radiation dominated astrophysical environments and field-driven surface catalysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次实验证实了在无机表面（水合二氧化硅纳米颗粒）上，X射线辐射驱动的电离条件下可以形成H₃⁺，并揭示了自诱导表面电场（V/nm尺度）是驱动界面电荷转移和水分解的关键参数，从而统一了辐射主导的天体物理环境与场驱动表面催化之间的机制。
AI.motivation: H₃⁺是星际空间中分子复杂性构建的关键物种，其经典生成反应H₂⁺ + H₂ → H₃⁺ + H在无机表面上是否能在辐射驱动的电离条件下发生，此前从未被实验验证过。
AI.method: 使用1.88 keV强X射线脉冲照射水合二氧化硅纳米颗粒，结合离子速度图成像、电子飞行时间光谱和单颗粒相干衍射成像技术，对单个颗粒上的化学过程进行解析；辅以密度泛函理论和非绝热量子分子动力学模拟。
AI.result: 实验证实了X射线辐射可驱动H₃⁺在无机表面的形成。V/nm尺度的自诱导表面电场是控制H⁺、H₂⁺和H₃⁺相对产率的主导参数，该效应跨越颗粒尺寸、组成和聚集状态均成立，其机制类似于半导体光电极的能带弯曲。
AI.conclusion: 表面场驱动的电荷转移为辐射主导的天体物理环境与场驱动表面催化提供了一个统一的机制框架，扩展了对星际化学及表面催化过程的基本理解。

title: Superfluid helium
summary: We are interested in modelling superfluid helium-4, the common isotope of helium, of atomic number 4. We present a mathematically solvable toy model of the phase transition between the normal liquid and superfluid phases and use it to show how an order parameter might be obtained for the superfluid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数学上可解的玩具模型，用于模拟超流氦-4中正常液相与超流相之间的相变，并展示如何为超流体获得序参量。
AI.motivation: 超流氦-4是常见的氦同位素（原子序数4），其超流相变是一个重要的物理现象。作者希望建立一个可解的数学模型来理解这一相变过程，并探讨序参量的获取方式。
AI.method: 提出了一个数学上可解的玩具模型来模拟正常液体与超流体之间的相变，并利用该模型展示如何为超流体导出序参量。
AI.result: 通过该玩具模型成功展示了超流体序参量的获取方法，为理解超流氦-4的相变提供了数学框架。
AI.conclusion: 该可解决的玩具模型为超流氦-4的相变及序参量提供了有价值的理论工具，有助于深入理解超流现象。

title: Strongly Enhanced Charge-Density Waves and Correlated Insulating State in Atomically Thin 1$T$-TaS$_2$
summary: We investigate thickness-dependent charge-density-wave (CDW) transitions in 1$T$-TaS$_2$ using temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and electrical transport. Raman measurements show that the incommensurate, nearly commensurate, and commensurate CDW phases persist down to the monolayer limit. As the thickness is reduced, the transition temperatures increase, accompanied by an orders-of-magnitude rise in sheet resistance and a sharp reduction in the carrier localization length. The first-order hysteretic CCDW-NCCDW transition is uniquely absent in the monolayer. Calculations suggest that the enhanced CDW in thin layers originates from strengthened Coulomb interactions due to reduced out-of-plane screening, particularly in the nonlocal component. These findings highlight the cooperative roles of electron correlation, electron-phonon interaction, and interlayer coupling in shaping the ground state and transition dynamics of atomically thin 1$T$-TaS$_2$, opening pathways for engineering correlated phases in two-dimensional CDW systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用变温拉曼光谱和电输运测量，系统研究了1T-TaS₂中电荷密度波（CDW）随厚度变化的相变行为。研究发现所有CDW相（非公度、近公度、公度）可持续存在至单层极限，但随厚度减薄，转变温度升高、面电阻增加数量级、载流子局域长度显著缩短。值得注意的是，单层中一阶滞后的CCDW-NCCDW转变消失。理论计算表明，减薄导致的层外屏蔽减弱增强了库仑相互作用（尤其非局域部分），从而强化了CDW。这些发现揭示了电子关联、电子-声子耦合和层间耦合在原子级薄1T-TaS₂基态和相变动力学中的协同作用。
AI.motivation: 探索二维极限下电荷密度波相变行为，理解层间耦合和电子关联如何影响CDW基态及转变动力学，为调控二维CDW系统中的关联相提供新路径。
AI.method: 采用变温拉曼光谱表征不同厚度样品的CDW相变，结合电输运测量（电阻率、载流子局域长度），并通过理论计算分析库仑相互作用的层厚依赖性及其对CDW的贡献。
AI.result: 所有CDW相在单层极限仍存在；厚度减薄导致转变温度升高、面电阻增加数个数量级、局域长度急剧减小；一阶滞后的CCDW-NCCDW转变在单层中消失；减薄增强了非局域库仑相互作用，促进CDW形成。
AI.conclusion: 层间耦合的减弱增强了非局域库仑相互作用，从而稳定并强化了薄层中的CDW。电子关联、电子-声子耦合和层间耦合三者协同决定了原子级薄1T-TaS₂的基态和相变动力学，为工程化二维CDW系统提供了新思路。

title: An Effective String Theory Toolbox for Quantum Hall Interfaces III: Open Worldsheets, Endpoint Conditions, and Branes
summary: A freely moving quantum Hall (QH) interface may end on a physical edge or topological boundary, but fixed-edge theory cannot determine what endpoint data make such a termination consistent. Here we formulate an open-worldsheet junction framework in which the embedding, material charge, anomaly flow, and topological boundary condition are organized together. The endpoint is specified by a geometric support and variational boundary data, together with condensable topological sectors and any outgoing channels required to absorb or continue the worldsheet flux. This construction extends the charge--shape relation to an interval and shows why a lone chiral Majorana cannot terminate on a finite-dimensional endpoint degree of freedom. It gives an operational definition of a QH brane and a systematic basis for endpoint and network theories of dynamical QH interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个开放世界面结框架，用于统一描述自由运动的量子霍尔（QH）界面的终点结构。该框架整合了嵌入、材料电荷、反常流和拓扑边界条件，并给出了QH膜的运作定义及终点/网络理论的系统基础。
AI.motivation: 自由运动的量子霍尔界面可能终止于物理边缘或拓扑边界，但固定边缘理论无法确定什么样的终点数据能使这种终止保持一致。这激发了构建一个更一般化的框架来理解QH界面终点的自洽性。
AI.method: 提出了开放世界面结（open-worldsheet junction）框架，将嵌入、材料电荷、反常流和拓扑边界条件组织在一起。终点由几何支撑和变分边界数据指定，同时结合可凝聚拓扑扇区和用于吸收或延续世界面通量的外流通道。
AI.result: 将电荷-形状关系扩展到区间，解释了为何单一的手性马约拉纳费米子无法终止于有限维终点自由度。对QH界面终点一致性的条件给出了系统的刻画。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了QH膜的运作定义，并为动力学QH界面的终点和网络理论建立了系统性基础。

title: Low-resistivity nitrogen-doped p-type Cu2O thin films enabled by millisecond flash lamp annealing
summary: Flash lamp annealing (FLA) provides millisecond-scale thermal processing, but its effects on p-type Cu2O and nitrogen-related defects remain poorly understood. Reactively sputtered Cu2O:N films with different nitrogen content were deposited using reactive high-power impulse magnetron sputtering and exposed to a single 1.9 ms FLA pulse at 4.9 - 11.7 J cm-2. Their compositional,morphological, structural, vibrational, electrical, and optical responses were evaluated. WDS showed no statistically significant change in total elemental composition, and XRD confirmed retention of cubic Cu2O. Nitrogen-containing films exhibited surface coarsening, shifts of the Cu2O reflections, and non-monotonic changes in the Raman band assigned to molecular N2. Nitrogen incorporation substantially reduced the as-deposited resistivity. The very low value of 0.045 Ωcm was obtained after FLA at 4.9 J cm-2, whereas higher energy densities markedly increased resistivity. Hall measurements showed increasing mobility but decreasing hole concentration. At high energy densities, the optical band gap of nitrogen-rich films widened. The results define a narrow low-energy processing window with a positive effect on electrical properties, whereas high-energy FLA modifies the structure and optical absorption edge but degrades electrical conductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了闪光灯退火（FLA）对反应溅射沉积的p型Cu2O:N薄膜的影响。研究发现仅在4.9 J/cm²的低能量密度下处理可以获得最佳电学性能（电阻率低至0.045 Ωcm），而高能量密度虽能调节结构和光学带隙，但会显著恶化电学性能，界定了一个狭窄的低能量工艺窗口。
AI.motivation: 闪光灯退火（FLA）具有毫秒级热处理的优势，但其对p型Cu2O及氮相关缺陷的影响尚不明确，缺乏系统的研究以确定合适的工艺参数。
AI.method: 采用反应高功率脉冲磁控溅射（HiPIMS）沉积不同氮含量的Cu2O:N薄膜，随后进行单次1.9 ms闪光灯退火处理（能量密度4.9-11.7 J/cm²），并全面评估其成分（WDS）、形貌、结构（XRD）、振动（Raman）、电学和光学性能。
AI.result: WDS显示总成分无显著变化，XRD确认保持立方Cu2O结构；含氮薄膜出现表面粗化、Cu2O衍射峰偏移及分子N2 Raman带非单调变化。氮掺入显著降低沉积态电阻率，在4.9 J/cm²退火后获得极低的0.045 Ωcm；但更高能量密度使电阻率大幅上升。Hall测试显示迁移率增加但空穴浓度降低；高能量密度下富氮薄膜光学带隙拓宽。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了低能量FLA处理对Cu2O:N电学性能有积极作用的狭窄工艺窗口，而高能量FLA虽可调控结构和光学吸收边，但会损害电学导电性，为Cu2O基薄膜的光热后处理提供了重要的工艺指导。

title: Rotational spectra and de-perturbation analysis for ground state ytterbium oxide, YbO
summary: A combination difference analysis of Fourier transform microwave spectroscopy (FTMW) measurements of $^{174}$YbO combined with earlier near-infrared chemiluminescence data have resulted in much improved YbO rotational and centrifugal distortion constants. These have been confirmed in a multi-isotopologue analysis of further FTMW measurements of $^{172}$YbO and $^{176}$YbO and an analysis of nuclear-size-dependent Born-Oppenheimer breakdown effects in the molecule. Multiple excited electronic states overlap with low-lying excited vibrational levels of the electronic ground state leading to irregularities in its vibrational spacings and other previously observed electronic manifolds. This has been modeled with a matrix of the vibrational levels of the ground and multiple interacting states assuming Morse potentials and including electronic Hamiltonian matrix elements mixing the states. Vibrational level overlaps were calculated numerically assuming Morse vibrational wavefunctions. The resulting de-perturbed potentials for the states inform continuing experimental and theoretical work on this and other ytterbium-containing molecules.

AI.tldr: 本文通过傅里叶变换微波光谱（FTMW）组合差分分析，结合近红外化学发光数据，显著改善了YbO分子的转动常数和离心畸变常数，并通过多同位素分析及核尺寸相关的Born-Oppenheimer破缺效应研究加以验证。针对基态低振动能级与多个激发电子态重叠导致的振动间距不规则现象，采用Morse势和电子哈密顿矩阵元混合的多态耦合模型进行了解析。
AI.motivation: 准确表征YbO分子的转动常数、离心畸变常数及其振动能级结构，理解激发电子态与基态振动能级间的相互作用，为后续实验和理论研究提供可靠的分子参数和去微扰势能面。
AI.method: 1. 对FTMW测量进行组合差分分析，并结合近红外化学发光数据获取更精确的转动和离心畸变常数；2. 开展多同位素（172YbO和176YbO）分析，并考虑核尺寸相关的Born-Oppenheimer破缺效应；3. 构建包含基态和多个相互作用电子态的振动能级矩阵模型，假设Morse势，包含电子哈密顿矩阵元混合项；4. 采用Morse振动波函数进行数值计算振动能级重叠积分。
AI.result: 获得了显著改进的YbO转动和离心畸变常数，成功解释了基态低振动能级与激发电子态重叠导致的振动间距不规则现象，并得到去微扰后的各电子态势能参数。
AI.conclusion: 去微扰后的势能面为YbO及其他含镱分子的后续实验和理论研究提供了重要参考依据。

title: Jsymm: A Python package for symmetry analysis of exchange tensors in magnetic Hamiltonians
summary: Symmetries of a crystal often restrict its physical properties. In particular, they determine possible forms of the tensors that describe interatomic exchange interaction, which governs a wide range of magnetic phenomena. Computationally demanding first-principles calculations of the exchange tensors can be greatly simplified by taking the symmetry constraints into account. Here, we present Jsymm, a Python package that derives the most general symmetry-compatible form of the exchange tensors directly from the crystallographic data. For any bond formed by magnetic ions, Jsymm produces the tensors of the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya and anisotropic Heisenberg exchange interaction in symbolic form, as well as the tensors for all other bonds related to it by symmetry. This reduces the number of independent model parameters, dramatically lowering the computational cost of the ab initio calculations and preventing unphysical results arising from symmetry violations. The package accepts standard CIF files and provides a web interface in addition to an interactive text mode and a Python library. We demonstrate its utility on La$_2$CuO$_4$ and $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$, reproducing known symmetry constraints and revealing additional relations between components of the exchange tensors of different bonds.

AI.tldr: Jsymm是一个Python包，直接从晶体学数据中推导交换相互作用张量（包含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya和各向异性Heisenberg交换）的最一般对称相容形式，减少独立模型参数数量，显著降低第一性原理计算成本，并防止因对称性违反导致的非物理结果。
AI.motivation: 晶体的对称性限制其物理性质，特别是决定描述原子间交换相互作用的张量形式。虽然第一性原理计算可以计算这些交换张量，但计算成本高昂，而利用对称性约束可以大幅简化这些计算。目前缺乏一个能直接从晶体学数据中自动推导对称相容交换张量形式的工具。
AI.method: 开发了Jsymm Python包，从标准CIF文件中读取晶体学数据，为任意磁离子构成的键生成Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya和各向异性Heisenberg交换张量的符号形式，同时生成所有对称相关的其他键的张量。提供Web界面、交互式文本模式和Python库三种使用方式。
AI.result: 在La₂CuO₄和α-Fe₂O₃上验证了该工具的有效性，成功复现了已知的对称性约束，并发现了不同键之间交换张量分量间的额外关系。
AI.conclusion: Jsymm有效减少了独立模型参数，显著降低从头算计算成本，防止因对称性违反产生的非物理结果，为磁性材料研究提供了一个实用的工具。

title: Morphology of frozen labyrinths from irreversible threshold dynamics
summary: Majority threshold dynamics, in which each agent adopts the dominant state in a weighted neighborhood, relaxes a binary field toward consensus or stripes. We study what happens when this rule is made irreversible: each agent, interacting through a Gaussian kernel on a lattice, may flip out of its local weighted minority at most once. The reversible form is threshold dynamics of Merriman-Bence-Osher type, an exactly solvable calibration in which interfaces move by mean curvature with closed-form lattice pinning and mobility. Irreversibility changes the outcome. From random initial conditions, the one-flip rule freezes balanced non-consensus labyrinths that reversible relaxation drives away. The patterned regime is a window of initial spin compositions around equal balance, narrowing as the interaction range grows, controlled by a standardized bias whose onset is independent of scale over a fourfold range. The frozen morphology is arrested coarsening: bicontinuous at balance, with a feature width that grows sublinearly and falls below the interaction range at large scales. We determine the mechanism by intervention. Fixing the initial condition while varying the update order shows that the coarse domain layout is deterministic, while the update order enters only in a secondary first-passage race that fine-tunes the wall positions the deterministic dynamics has already set. Those walls are marked by frustration: agents frozen against their own local field. This signature is identically absent from any reversible relaxation, is overwhelmingly interfacial, and carries almost none of the pattern's large-scale shape.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了不可逆的多数阈值动力学：每个智能体在加权邻域中至多翻转一次以脱离局部加权少数态。从随机初始条件出发，该"单次翻转"规则会冻结平衡的非共识迷宫结构，而这些结构在可逆松弛中会被驱散。冻结形态呈现停滞粗化特征，在平衡点处为双连续结构，特征宽度次线性增长。通过干预实验发现，粗粒度域布局是确定性的，更新顺序仅在次要的首达竞赛中起作用以微调界面位置。冻结界面以受挫（智能体逆自身局部场冻结）为标志，这在可逆松弛中完全不存在。
AI.motivation: 理解不可逆性如何改变多数阈值动力学的行为。可逆形式（MBO型阈值动力学）已有精确解，但不可逆的"单次翻转"规则从随机初始条件产生不同的结果——冻结的迷宫结构，需要理解其机制和标度性质。
AI.method: 在晶格上使用高斯核交互的多数阈值动力学，将其改为不可逆形式（每个智能体最多翻转一次）。从随机初始条件出发，通过改变更新顺序进行干预实验，以区分确定性布局与随机性的作用。
AI.result: 单次翻转规则冻结平衡的非共识迷宫结构。图案化区域是初始自旋组成围绕等平衡的窗口，随相互作用范围增大而变窄。冻结形态为停滞粗化：平衡时双连续，特征宽度次线性增长。确定粗粒度域布局是确定性的，更新顺序仅在次要的首达竞赛中微调界面位置。冻结界面带有受挫特征，这在可逆松弛中完全不存在
AI.conclusion: 不可逆性从根本上改变了阈值动力学的结局：从驱散转变为冻结迷宫。该现象由确定性动力学的粗尺度布局决定，更新顺序只起次要作用，而受挫界面是冻结状态的独特标志。

title: Local Spin Excitations Mediate Quasiparticle Breakdown in the Orbital-Selective Mott Phase
summary: The orbital-selective Mott phase (OSMP) is commonly described as a coexistence of localized and itinerant electrons within effectively decoupled orbitals, but emerging evidence for quasiparticle breakdown points to physics beyond this picture, whose microscopic origin remains unknown. Using dynamical mean-field theory for the two-band Hubbard model, we show that the spin-flip and Ising-type components of Hund's coupling generate local spin excitations (LSEs). These LSEs couple electrons between different orbitals, renormalize quasiparticle lifetimes and binding energies, and thereby destroy well-defined quasiparticles in the OSMP. Removing these two components of Hund's coupling restores coherent quasiparticle behavior and fully decouples the charge dynamics of the two bands. Our results therefore identify electronic coupling to LSEs as the fundamental mechanism driving quasiparticle breakdown within the OSMP.

AI.tldr: 本文通过动力学平均场理论（DMFT）研究两带Hubbard模型，发现Hund耦合的自旋翻转和Ising型分量产生局域自旋激发（LSEs），这些激发在轨道间耦合电子，重塑准粒子寿命和束缚能，从而破坏轨道选择性Mott相（OSMP）中的准粒子行为。去除这些分量可恢复相干准粒子并解耦两带的电荷动力学。
AI.motivation: OSMP传统上被描述为在有效解耦的轨道中局域电子与巡游电子共存，但新出现的准粒子击穿证据表明物理机制超越这一图像，其微观起源尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用动力学平均场理论（DMFT）对两带Hubbard模型进行数值研究，系统分析Hund耦合的不同分量（自旋翻转项和Ising型项）对准粒子行为的影响。
AI.result: 发现Hund耦合的自旋翻转和Ising型分量产生局域自旋激发（LSEs），这些激发在轨道间耦合电子、重塑准粒子寿命和束缚能，从而破坏OSMP中的明确定义准粒子。移除这两个分量后，相干准粒子行为恢复，两带的电荷动力学完全解耦。
AI.conclusion: 识别出电子与局域自旋激发（LSEs）的耦合是驱动OSMP内准粒子击穿的基本机制。

title: Beyond Electrons: Radiative Thermal Computing and Neural Networks at the Near-Field Limit
summary: We propose and analyze a programmable near-field radiative thermal network that emulates convolutional and recurrent operations through heat exchange. By integrating radiative thermal diodes and transistors composed of phase-change materials such as VO2 and GST, we construct two fundamental architectures: the Thermal Convolutional Neural Network (T-CNN) and the Thermal Recurrent Neural Network (T-RNN). The T-CNN executes spatial pattern recognition via temperature-dependent emissivity modulation, where each gate acts as a tunable radiative filter that amplifies or suppresses localized heat flux. The system is externally programmable via gate temperature distributions in VO2/GST, enabling weighted summation and nonlinear activation; hysteretic transitions provide state dependent responses that can be harnessed for memory. The T-RNN extends this functionality temporally, embedding radiative feedback and hysteretic phase transitions to realize memory and sequential inference. Together, these systems exhibit tri-state logic behavior, radiative gain, and non-volatile thermal storage, key attributes of physical learning. Each logical node operates without charge carriers or electrical circuits, relying solely on near-field photon tunneling between nanoscale surfaces. The resulting framework enables direct implementation of convolution, memory retention, and feedback learning within a contactless, energy-conserving platform. This study establishes the first radiative realization of thermal deep learning, revealing a new computing paradigm where temperature fields function as carriers of intelligence, uniting heat transfer, memory, and adaptive inference in a single non-electronic system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一个可编程的近场辐射热网络，通过热交换来模拟卷积和循环运算。利用VO2和GST等相变材料构成的辐射热二极管和晶体管，构建了热卷积神经网络（T-CNN）和热循环神经网络（T-RNN）两种基本架构，实现了无需电荷载流子或电路的非电子热深度学习平台。
AI.motivation: 传统电子计算基于电荷载流子进行信息处理，本文旨在探索一种全新的非电子计算范式——利用温度场和热辐射作为信息载体，实现深度学习中的卷积、记忆和反馈学习等核心操作，从而建立首个辐射式热深度学习的物理实现。
AI.method: 将相变材料（VO2、GST）用于构建辐射热二极管和晶体管，并通过门温度分布进行外部可编程控制。T-CNN通过温度依赖性发射率调制实现空间模式识别，每个门作为可调辐射滤波器；T-RNN通过辐射反馈和滞回相变实现时间维度的记忆和序列推理。系统完全依赖近场光子隧穿，无需电荷或电路。
AI.result: 系统表现出三态逻辑行为、辐射增益和非易失性热存储等物理学习的关键属性。每个逻辑节点仅依赖纳米表面间的近场光子隧穿运作，实现了卷积、记忆保持和反馈学习的直接实施，在一个无接触、能量守恒的平台上。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次实现了辐射式热深度学习的物理验证，揭示了温度场可以作为智能载体的全新计算范式，将热传递、记忆和自适应推理统一在一个非电子系统中，为未来计算架构开辟了新的可能性。

title: Antiferromagnetic Phases in Zr-Fe-Ge Kagome Systems
summary: A wide variety of chemical substitutions in ferromagnetic Kagome systems can lead to diverse magnetic phases with electronic structures suitable for topological or quantum material properties. Here, we study the electronic structure and magnetic orderings using first-principles calculations for the magnetic Kagome compounds ZrFe6Ge6, ZrFe6Ge4, and ZrFe6Ge5. For ZrFe6Ge6, the obtained ground-state magnetic structure is A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM), in agreement with existing experiments. We predicted that the magnetic ground states of ZrFe6Ge4 and ZrFe6Ge5 are collinear A-type bilayer AFM structures with long-period ordering that involves a mix of FM and AFM interlayer orientations. The formation of such long-range magnetic structures appears to be a general feature and is not tied to specific substitutions. The magnetic moments in these systems are largely local and only weakly dependent on the magnetic configuration, with magnitudes in good agreement with available experimental estimates. Neutron scattering experiments, which could provide direct verification of these predictions, are therefore of particular importance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了磁性Kagome化合物ZrFe6Ge6、ZrFe6Ge4和ZrFe6Ge5的电子结构和磁有序性。研究发现ZrFe6Ge6的基态为A型反铁磁（AFM），与实验一致；而ZrFe6Ge4和ZrFe6Ge5则预测为具有长周期序的共线A型双层反铁磁结构（包含铁磁与反铁磁层间取向的混合）。这种长程磁性结构的形成似乎是普遍特征，而非特定取代所特有。磁矩在很大程度上是局域的，且对磁构型依赖性较弱，与现有实验估计吻合良好。

AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论）对三种ZrFe6Ge6、ZrFe6Ge4和ZrFe6Ge5磁性Kagome化合物进行电子结构和磁有序性研究，通过比较不同磁构型的能量来确定基态磁性结构。

title: A Phase Space Electronic Structure View of The Solid State
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, main text and SM
summary: We develop a phase space electronic structure view of the solid state, where electronic bands are parameterized by both nuclear position $\mathbf{Q}$ and nuclear momentum $\mathbfΠ$ (rather than the standard practice of only $\mathbf{Q}$). Within this phase space, non-Born-Oppenheimer electronic structure context, we prove a nuclear wavevector ($\mathbf{q}$)-dependent version of Nafie's equality relating the change in electronic momentum as a function of nuclear momentum, $\partial \langle\mathbf{p}\rangle/\partial \mathbfΠ_q$, to the change in electronic position as a function of nuclear position, $\partial \langle\mathbf{r}\rangle/\partial \mathbf{Q}q$. Furthermore, we show how information about electron-phonon interactions, specifically nuclear-induced electronic momentum, can be extracted from simple band structure calculations -- without Berry curvature calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文在相空间（同时包含核位置Q和核动量Π）框架下发展了固态电子结构理论，证明了核波矢q依赖的Nafie等式，并展示了无需Berry曲率计算即可从能带结构提取电子-声子相互作用信息的方法。
AI.motivation: 传统固态电子结构仅以核位置Q为参数描述电子能带，忽略了核动量的作用。作者希望建立更完整的相空间电子结构视角，以更好地理解非Born-Oppenheimer（非绝热）效应以及电子-声子相互作用。
AI.method: 在相空间电子结构框架中，将电子能带参数化为核位置Q和核动量Π的函数。基于此框架，推导出核波矢q依赖的Nafie等式，建立电子动量对核动量的偏导数与电子位置对核位置的偏导数之间的等价关系。
AI.result: 成功证明了q依赖的Nafie等式，并表明核诱导的电子动量信息可以从简单的能带结构计算中提取，无需进行Berry曲率计算。
AI.conclusion: 相空间电子结构视角提供了一个更完整的固态电子结构描述框架，为从常规能带计算中获取电子-声子相互作用信息开辟了新途径，避免了昂贵的Berry曲率计算。

title: Entanglement Scaling and Full Counting Statistics in Excited States of Two-Dimensional Rotating Fermions
summary: We investigate the entanglement entropy of a class of $N$-particle excited state of fermions confined in a two-dimensional harmonic trap rotating at an angular frequency $Ω$. The excited state is constructed by filling a particular set of $N$ single-particle energy levels. We analytically compute the Rényi entropies of order $q$ in a disc of radius $r$ around the centre of the trap, and the cumulants corresponding to number fluctuations of fermions within the disc. We found that the area law scaling of entanglement entropy holds even for a class of excited states. We also verified the well-known series expansion of entanglement entropy in terms of the particle number cumulants for non-interacting fermions. We further derive the centered cumulant generating function, demonstrating that the associated probability distribution function in the disc has identical scaling properties, up to a variable shift, to the known ground-state result. Finally, we extend our result to an annular region, showing that both the Rényi entropy and particle number cumulants of the annulus decompose into sums of the corresponding quantities of the two bounding discs. These additive relations hold as long as the width of the annulus is sufficiently large.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维谐振子势中旋转费米子激发态的纠缠熵，解析计算了盘中Rényi熵和粒子数涨落累积量，证明纠缠熵的面积律对激发态仍然成立，并扩展到了环形区域。
AI.motivation: 大多数关于纠缠熵的研究集中在基态，而对激发态的纠缠特性研究较少。作者希望探讨在旋转二维谐振子势中的费米子激发态是否仍保持面积律，以及激发态与基态在纠缠特性上是否有一致的标度行为。
AI.method: 作者构造了填充特定单粒子能级集合的N粒子激发态，利用解析方法计算了阶数q的Rényi熵和盘中粒子数涨落的累积量，推导出中心累积量生成函数，并将结果从圆盘推广到环形区域。
AI.result: 发现面积律标度对这类激发态依然成立；验证了无相互作用费米子纠缠熵按粒子数累积量展开的级数；证明了环中Rényi熵和粒子数累积量可分解为两个边界圆盘相应量之和（在环宽足够大时）。
AI.conclusion: 激发态与基态在纠缠熵标度性质上具有一致性（除变量平移外），面积律对激发态仍然成立，且环状区域的加法分解关系为理解几何与纠缠结构之间的关系提供了新视角。

title: Helical-to-Fan Transitions under Magnetic Fields in the Noncentrosymmetric Tetragonal Magnet EuRhGe$_3$
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, accepted for publication in J. Phys. Soc. Jpn
summary: The magnetic structure of EuRhGe$_3$, a noncentrosymmetric body-centered tetragonal magnet with the space group $I4mm$, has been investigated by resonant X-ray diffraction. Below $T_{\text{N}}=12$ K, EuRhGe$_3$ undergoes a helical magnetic ordering with an incommensurate propagation vector $q=(0, 0, 0.809)$, in which the magnetic moments lie in the $ab$ plane and rotate by a constant turn angle of $145.8^{\circ}$ between adjacent layers. When a magnetic field is applied along the $a$ axis at 2 K, a second-harmonic $2q$ peak develops, indicating that the circular helix is gradually distorted into a helimagnetic soliton-lattice state, which eventually undergoes a lock-in transition to the commensurate structure with $q=0.8$ at 3.8 T. Above the subsequent phase boundary at 5 T, the helicity is lost, and a spin-flop $xyz$-fan (elliptic conical) state is realized, in which the moments oscillate predominantly along the $b$ axis but are accompanied by a small $c$-axis component. At higher fields, the system enters a conventional planar $xy$-fan phase without a $c$-axis component. EuRhGe$_3$ provides a prototypical example of a helimagnet that exhibits a full sequence of field-induced structures, evolving from a circular helix to a spin-flop $xyz$-fan (elliptic conical), and finally to a planar $xy$-fan structure, which has been theoretically predicted.

AI.tldr: 本文通过共振X射线衍射研究了非中心对称体心四方磁体EuRhGe₃的磁结构。在TN=12 K以下，该材料呈现螺旋磁有序（传播矢量q=(0,0,0.809)，层间转角145.8°）。施加磁场后，系统经历一系列场致相变：圆螺旋逐渐畸变为螺旋磁孤子晶格态（锁相至q=0.8），随后进入自旋翻转xyz-扇（椭圆锥）态，最终达到平面xy-扇态。EuRhGe₃为理论预测的完整场致结构序列提供了原型范例。
AI.motivation: 研究非中心对称磁体中磁场诱导的完整磁结构演化序列，验证理论上预测的从圆螺旋到自旋翻转椭圆锥扇再到平面xy-扇的相变过程，填补实验上的空白。
AI.method: 采用共振X射线衍射（RXD）技术，在零场和不同磁场条件下（沿a轴施加磁场，温度2 K）系统测量EuRhGe₃的磁结构，通过分析衍射峰（包括基本q峰和二阶2q谐波）确定磁有序的演化路径。

AI.conclusion: EuRhGe₃是首个在实验中完整展示了从圆螺旋态经孤子晶格态、自旋翻转xyz-扇态到平面xy-扇态全部场致磁结构演化序列的螺旋磁体，为理论预测提供了直接的实验验证，是该类材料的原型体系。

title: Unconventional Scaling of Electric Hall Effect in Magnetic Weyl Semimetals
summary: Electric Hall Effect (EHE), a unique phenomenon in two-dimensional (2D) magnetic systems, refers to the generation of Hall current by an out-of-plane electric field $\Ez$. Here, we demonstrate that for 2D magnetic Weyl semimetals that host doubly degenerate nodal points, the EHE features multiple unconventional scaling laws. At zero temperature, the EHE exhibits a topological $E_F^{-1}$ Fermi-energy scaling. Remarkably, the prefactor of the scaling is determined by the global topological charge of the point without any dependence on the local parameters of the system, leading to a universal and significant enhancement of Hall response in any species of Weyl points as the Fermi energy approaches the Weyl point. This significant response enables a weak electric field to be directly converted into a measurable Hall signal. Surprisingly, this enhanced Hall response is not diminished by temperature, but evolves into an unconventional logarithmically corrected scaling at finite temperature $σ_{xy}\propto\Ez\ln(1/|\Ez|)$ for weak $\Ez$, still yielding a divergent electric-field susceptibility. Thus, our work not only unveils intriguing scaling laws resulting from the interaction between magnetism and topology, but also suggests a novel scaling-enhanced and temperature-robust mechanism that may enable weak electric-field sensing through a practical and all-electric route.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维磁性Weyl半金属中的电霍尔效应（EHE），发现该系统表现出多种非传统标度律：零温下呈拓扑的E_F^{-1}费米能量标度，其前因子由Weyl点的全局拓扑荷决定；有限温度下则演化为对数修正标度σ_xy∝E_z ln(1/|E_z|)，温度不会削弱增强的霍尔响应，反而保持发散的电致磁化率。
AI.motivation: 电霍尔效应是二维磁系统中由垂直电场产生霍尔电流的独特现象，但其在不同材料体系中的标度行为尚不清楚，特别是在具有双重简并节点的磁性Weyl半金属中，电场与拓扑之间的相互作用如何影响霍尔响应值得深入探索。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析二维磁性Weyl半金属中双重简并非简并节点的拓扑性质，分别在零温和有限温度条件下推导电霍尔电导率的解析表达式，研究其随费米能量和电场强度的标度行为。
AI.result: 发现零温下EHE呈现拓扑性的E_F^{-1}标度，前因子仅依赖于Weyl点的全局拓扑荷而与局域参数无关；有限温度下增强的霍尔响应不衰减，演化为σ_xy∝E_z ln(1/|E_z|)的对数修正标度，电场磁化率仍然发散。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了磁性与拓扑相互作用产生的独特标度律，并提出了一种标度增强且温度鲁棒的弱电场探测机制，可通过全电学路径实现实际应用。

title: Intra-unit-cell resolved intertwining of multi-$Q$ charge and spin textures in an itinerant skyrmion magnet
summary: The mechanisms stabilizing non-collinear magnetism in centrosymmetric crystals remain unclear, but likely involve spin-spin interactions mediated by itinerant electrons, such as the RKKY interaction. Finite-$Q$ magnetic order may then be accompanied by electronic modulations that are observable using a scanning tunneling microscope. In five successive magnetic phases of GdRu$_{2}$Ge$_{2}$, including two nano-scale skyrmion crystal phases, we show that multi-$Q$ magnetism among Gd 4$f$ spins entails a corresponding multi-$Q$ texture among the Ru 4$d$ orbitals that contribute itinerant electron bands. With atomically-resolved images of each electronic texture's motif, and a simple numerical modeling scheme drawing on the underlying spin structures, we infer their key relationship: The alignment between nearest-neighbor Gd spins tightly correlates with the local density-of-states of the Ru 4$d$ orbitals on the two bond-centered sublattices of the Gd square net. These analyses offer a microscopic view of the atomic-scale intertwining of charge and spin degrees-of-freedom in non-collinear itinerant magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扫描隧道显微镜在GdRu₂Ge₂的五种磁性相（包括两种纳米尺寸的斯格明子晶体相）中，揭示了Gd 4f自旋的多Q磁性结构伴随着Ru 4d轨道的多Q电子纹理。通过原子分辨成像和数值建模，发现最近邻Gd自旋的排列方向与Ru 4d轨道的局域态密度密切相关，为理解非共线磁性材料中电荷与自旋自由度的原子尺度交织提供了微观视角。
AI.motivation: 非共线磁性与中心对称晶体中的稳定机制尚不明确，可能涉及由巡游电子介导的自旋-自旋相互作用（如RKKY相互作用）。作者希望通过实验观察有限Q磁序伴随的电子调制，揭示电荷与自旋自由度之间的耦合关系。
AI.method: 在GdRu₂Ge₂的五种连续磁性相中进行原子分辨扫描隧道显微镜（STM）测量，观察Ru 4d轨道的电子纹理；同时结合简单数值建模方案，基于底层自旋结构推理电子纹理与自旋排列之间的关联。
AI.result: 证明了多Q磁性（涉及Gd 4f自旋）对应着Ru 4d轨道（贡献巡游电子能带）的多Q纹理。发现最近邻Gd自旋的排列方向与Gd方格子两个键中心子格上Ru 4d轨道的局域态密度紧密相关。
AI.conclusion: 这些分析为理解非共线巡游磁性材料中电荷与自旋自由度在原子尺度上的相互交织提供了微观视角，有助于阐明RKKY等巡游电子介导相互作用在稳定非共线磁结构中的作用机制。

title: Nuclear-Spin Statistical Weights from Young Diagrams
summary: Nuclear-spin statistical weights and selection rules in molecular spectroscopy are governed by the permutation symmetry of identical nuclei, although rigid and semi-rigid molecules typically realize only a proper subgroup of the full symmetric group. Building on the Schur-Weyl framework of Schmiedt, Jensen, and Schlemmer, we extend this approach to molecular geometries whose rovibrational motion realizes cyclic and dihedral permutation subgroups. By combining the Schur-Weyl decomposition of the $n$-spin Hilbert space with the Kraśkiewicz-Weyman-Adin-Roichman major-index branching rule for the restriction $S_N \downarrow C_m$, we obtain a fully combinatorial method for determining nuclear-spin symmetry species and statistical weights. Each standard Young tableau corresponds to a definite cyclic character determined by its major index, with reflections yielding the associated dihedral symmetry, so that nuclear-spin species follow directly from tableau data without projection operators or case-specific constructions. Applications to $XeOF_4$, $SF_4$, benzene, deuterated benzene, and the tropylium cation demonstrate that the method applies uniformly to realistic molecular point groups and reproduces established statistical weights while providing a transparent spin-resolved structure. The approach supplies the symmetry information required for rovibrational line-intensity modeling and provides a practical, automatable framework for nuclear-spin symmetry analysis in polyatomic molecules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个完全组合学的方法来确定分子光谱中的核自旋统计权重，通过结合Schur-Weyl分解与Kraśkiewicz-Weyman-Adin-Roichman major-index分支规则，将S_N到C_m（循环群）和D_m（二面体群）的限制进行组合学处理。每个标准杨表通过其major index对应确定的循环特征，无需投影算子即可直接从杨表数据获得核自旋对称性物种。方法在XeOF4、SF4、苯、氘代苯和草鎓阳离子等分子上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 分子光谱学中核自旋统计权重和选择定则由全同核的排列对称性决定，但刚性/半刚性分子通常只实现全对称群的适当子群。已有的Schmiedt-Jensen-Schlemmer框架基于Schur-Weyl理论，但尚未系统覆盖实现循环群（C_m）和二面体群（D_m）置换子群的分子几何结构。需要一个统一、可自动化且无需逐例构建的方法来处理这些情况。
AI.method: 将n自旋希尔伯特空间的Schur-Weyl分解与Kraśkiewicz-Weyman-Adin-Roichman major-index分支规则（用于S_N↓C_m的限制）相结合。每个标准杨表通过其major index确定一个明确的循环特征，而反射操作给出相应的二面体对称性，从而直接从杨表数据获得核自旋对称性物种和统计权重，无需投影算子或针对特定情况的构造。
AI.result: 方法在XeOF4、SF4、苯、氘代苯和草鎓阳离子等实际分子上得到验证，统一适用于现实分子点群，重现了已建立的统计权重，同时提供了透明的自旋分辨结构。
AI.conclusion: 该组合学方法为多原子分子的核自旋对称性分析提供了实用、可自动化的框架，为振动-转动谱线强度建模提供了所需的对称性信息。

title: Computing Shear Viscosities from Molecular Dynamics Simulation: Comparing the OrthoBoXY Approach with the Green-Kubo Method
summary: We calculated shear viscosities of 15 neat molecular liquids from equilibrium molecular dynamics (MD) simulations using the OrthoBoXY approach and compare them to viscosities calculated via the Green-Kubo method. Data from both methods agree very well. Here, we show how to avoid pitfalls while computing the OrthoBoXY-data to obtain optimal results. From simulations of multiple system sizes, we could verify that the viscosity of molecular liquids is not influenced by finite size effects down to systems as small as 250 molecules. Moreover, we demonstrate that also the standard error of the viscosity is nearly independent of the system size. This is shown to be a consequence of a compensation effect of an increasing accuracy of the self-diffusion coefficients with increasing systems-size and the system-size dependent weighting according to the OrthoBoXY-equation. As a consequence, we suggest that it is preferable to run simulations of smaller systems with longer simulation times rather than larger systems with shorter simulation runs. In addition, we discuss a refinement of the recently introduced "recipe" for OrthoBoXY simulations block-lengths $τ_\mathrm{block}$. Based on data from simulations with varying run-lengths, we suggest the following modification: for highly viscous systems, the value of $τ_\mathrm{block}$ might safely be scaled by a factor of $1/8$, significantly reducing the computational resources needed. For less viscous systems, the value of $τ_\mathrm{block}$ might safely be scaled by a factor of $1/4$. For systems with high fluidity, the value of $τ_\mathrm{block}$ should not be scaled down in order to achieve reliable results. When using a smaller system size of 250 molecules, these refinements are leading up to a 24-fold reduction in computational cost compared to the previous recommended set-up without sacrificing numerical accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文使用OrthoBoXY方法计算了15种纯净分子液体的剪切粘度，并与Green-Kubo方法结果进行了对比验证。研究发现粘度不受有限尺寸效应影响（小至250个分子），且标准误差几乎与系统大小无关。作者建议用小系统+长模拟时间而非大系统+短模拟，并提出对OrthoBoXY块长度τ_block的改进配方，可将计算成本降低最多24倍。
AI.motivation: 粘度是分子液体重要的输运性质，准确计算剪切粘度对工业和科研具有重要意义。OrthoBoXY方法是近期提出的一种高效计算粘度的替代方法，但其最佳实践、系统尺寸效应以及计算效率优化尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 通过平衡分子动力学模拟计算15种分子液体的剪切粘度，比较OrthoBoXY与Green-Kubo两种方法的计算差异；模拟多种系统尺寸（最小250分子）以检验有限尺寸效应；通过改变运行长度来优化OrthoBoXY的块长度τ_block配方。
AI.result: 两种方法结果高度一致；粘度不受有限尺寸效应影响（小至250分子）；标准误差在系统中自扩散系数精度与系统尺寸依赖的加权因子间存在补偿效应而几乎不变；提出将τ_block按系统粘性程度缩放1/8或1/4可显著降低计算成本，高流动性系统不宜缩小；结合小系统尺寸可实现最多24倍计算成本缩减。
AI.conclusion: 建议在OrthoBoXY模拟中优先选择小系统尺寸（如250分子）配以更长的模拟时间；根据系统粘度对τ_block进行适当缩放可大幅降低计算资源需求而不牺牲数值精度。

title: Correlated topological-polarization surface states in the narrow-gap insulator FeSb2
summary: Strong electron correlations and band topology each generate rich quantum phases, but conflicting elemental requirements have largely kept them apart. Topological polarization offers a route to unite them, producing polar surface states from bonding charge without spin-orbit coupling and thereby extending band topology to correlated 3d transition-metal compounds. Here we demonstrate that epitaxial thin films of the narrow-gap insulator FeSb2 host metallic polar surface states of topological-polarization origin, governed by the strong correlations of the bulk. Nonreciprocal surface transport emerges only below the onset temperature of a correlation-driven reconstruction of the bulk Fe 3d orbital occupation, providing direct evidence of bulk-edge correspondence in a correlated topological system. Moreover, electrostatic gating drives this correlated surface across a quantum phase transition into a ferromagnetic or possibly altermagnetic state. Our results establish topological polarization as a design principle for correlated topological phases in a broad range of materials.

AI.tldr: 本文在窄带隙绝缘体FeSb2的外延薄膜中证明了拓扑极化起源的金属极性表面态，该表面态由体相强关联主导。仅当体相Fe 3d轨道占据发生关联驱动的重构后，才出现非互易表面输运，直接证明关联拓扑系统中的体边对应。静电门控还能驱动该关联表面态穿过量子相变进入铁磁或可能的交变磁态。
AI.motivation: 强电子关联和能带拓扑各自都能产生丰富的量子相，但由于元素要求冲突，两者很难在同一材料中共存。本文旨在通过拓扑极化这一途径将二者统一，将能带拓扑拓展到关联3d过渡金属化合物中，从而在关联体系中实现拓扑相。
AI.method: 制备FeSb2外延薄膜（窄带隙绝缘体），通过实验观测其表面态与输运性质；利用体相Fe 3d轨道占据的关联驱动重构来关联表面输运行为；利用静电门控调控关联表面态，探索量子相变。
